reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his #central-team thread. I said I'm treating "the Jasper rollout site at Marrow Fieldworks is Bay 15" as unconfirmed. I won't rely on Bay 15 until someone who owns the rollout confirms it. I also offered to ask the channel for confirmation.

I checked the channel history and public files Tobias can see, and nothing backs up his tip. A keyword search for "Jasper", "Fieldworks" and "Bay 15" found no matching pages. The only place the claim shows up is his own message, which the workspace knowledge base saved automatically.
